_metadata.description: Curated 35-product v4 canary set spanning 14 primary classes (single_nutrient, multivitamin, prenatal_multi, probiotic, fish_oil, herbal_branded_extract / unstandardized / marker_pct, sports_opaque / transparent, specialty, greens_superfood, blocked_verdict, manufacturer_signal_only) and all 4 B5 router class routes (probiotic / multi_or_prenatal / sports_active / generic). Each entry encodes expected_b5_class, expected_dose_route_v4, edge_cases, and v3 shipped score/verdict for regression baselining.
_metadata.purpose: v4 dose + B5 class-aware + cert coverage canary set. Used by test_v4_canary_coverage.py to guarantee every product class + edge case the v4 design depends on is exercised on real shipped data. Add a new entry before adding a new class to the scorer; remove an entry only with a decision log note. Source of truth for canary-based regression review and the score-delta report.

retired_canaries.reason: The previous retirement note attributed catalog absence to FDA enforcement without supporting evidence. Catalog exclusion does not establish removal from the market. Restored on 2026-09-11 after adding the verified IQM identity; the current policy is CAUTION with a quality score.

_metadata.notes: expected_b5_class is the v4-correct routing decision. Where the current scorer disagrees, the discrepancy is captured in edge_cases as 'router_disagreement_*' so test_v4_canary_coverage flags (not fails) until the router fix lands.

golden_set.purpose: v4 golden set: each canary states expected route, statuses, a tier band and pillar invariants. The Coverage & Calibration dashboard raises a finding when a canary breaks one; a break is fixed at its owner or explained by an allowed movement reason, never by editing the expectation to the current score.

expectation_owners.expected_product_safety_status: scripts/scoring_v4/scored_artifact.py::_product_safety_status (catalog safety gate only; never legacy verdict)
expectation_owners.expected_quality_tier_band: scripts/scoring_v4/quality_score.py::_tier over scripts/scoring_v4/config/quality_score.json tiers, read from the public display score; band = tiers reachable within +/-5 points of the reviewed score (drift tolerance, not a ranking)

tier_matches_display_score.rule: quality_tier is the configured tier of the public display score.

pillars_sum_to_score.rule: The six public pillars add up to quality_score_v4_100 (within rounding).

verification_unknown_neutral.rule: Verification stays at the neutral 6/15 when no verification evidence is on file (unknown is not a penalty).

verification_claim_or_brand_ceiling.rule: Label claims, own testing and reputation without independent verification stay at or below 8/15.

verification_manufacturing_ceiling.rule: Verified facility or brand-scoped evidence without product-level certification stays at or below 10/15.

verification_product_floor.rule: Registry-backed product-level certification earns at least 11/15.

dose_unbenchmarked_neutral.rule: A disclosed amount with no applicable benchmark takes the shared Dose neutral 11.4, never a studied-range claim.

dose_ul_partial_ceiling.rule: A confirmed UL exceedance above 100% and below 150% at maximum directed daily use caps public Dose at 10.

dose_ul_zero_ceiling.rule: A confirmed UL exceedance at or above 150% at maximum directed daily use sets public Dose to 0.

dose_caffeine_zero_ceiling.rule: Declared caffeine of 600 mg/day or more at maximum directed daily use sets public Dose to 0 through the same ceiling.

dose_caffeine_below_ceiling.rule: Declared caffeine at or below 400 mg/day at maximum directed daily use sets no Dose ceiling.

dose_ceiling_applied_once.rule: One product-level Dose ceiling, applied once after route aggregation (at most one ceiling receipt entry).
dose_ceiling_applied_once.owner: scripts/scoring_v4/config/quality_score.json dose_safety_ceiling (_doc: applied once after route aggregation and normalization)

ul_exceedance_not_double_counted.rule: A UL exceedance is charged once in Dose; Safety/Hygiene says so instead of deducting again.

evidence_applicable_assessed.rule: Reviewed applicable research is shown as an assessed Evidence result.

evidence_authority_assessed.rule: Essential nutrients are assessed through established nutritional authority.

evidence_applicability_gap_not_no_resear.rule: An Evidence applicability gap is shown as research that does not apply to this label, never as no research, and it is a completed conclusion.

evidence_reviewed_zero_is_assessed.rule: A reviewed null or no-qualifying-evidence result is an assessed conclusion, distinct from a pending review.

evidence_pending_marks_partial.rule: An Evidence review PharmaGuide has not finished is shown as pending (not 0/20 research) and marks the assessment partial.

evidence_single_active_not_nothing_to_as.rule: A label whose only active has a resolved evidence owner is never reported as having nothing to assess; it is reviewed or pending.
evidence_single_active_not_nothing_to_as.owner: scripts/scoring_v4/quality_score.py::evidence_display_state ('not_applicable - nothing on this label to assess'); scripts/scoring_v4/modules/generic_evidence.py (evidence_owner_canonicals)

omega_carrier_mass_not_epa_dha.rule: Fish-oil carrier mass never becomes EPA+DHA dose: undisclosed EPA/DHA earns no Dose credit.

suppressed_hides_score_keeps_reason.rule: A BLOCKED product ships with its reason and no public quality number or tier.
suppressed_hides_score_keeps_reason.owner: scripts/scoring_v4/quality_score.py::assemble_quality_score (hard safety failure first); scripts/scoring_v4/scored_artifact.py::_public_verdict; AGENTS.md 'Banned/recalled products always ship'

safety_block_precedes_completeness.rule: A safety block wins over an incomplete-data gate: the product is BLOCKED, not NOT_SCORED.

not_scored_has_no_number.rule: A not-scored product carries no number, tier or pillars and an honest partial assessment.

unresolved_dose_safety_hold.rule: Material but unresolved dose safety (e.g. no reference for the label's age band) holds the product from scoring instead of guessing.

caution_keeps_quality_score.rule: Quality and safety are separate outputs: a CAUTION product keeps its quality score.

high_risk_active_zeroes_safety_hygiene.rule: A confirmed high-risk active zeroes the Safety/Hygiene base while the product stays scored with CAUTION.

watchlist_excipient_not_blocking.rule: A watchlist excipient (titanium dioxide) informs and takes a small Safety/Hygiene deduction; it never blocks or forces CAUTION.

unfinished_identity_marks_partial.rule: PharmaGuide's own unresolved identity marks the assessment partial instead of presenting a finished verdict.

golden_set.check_ops: eq, ne, in, le, ge, lt, gt, is_null, not_null, nonempty, contains (list), contains_text, not_contains_text (case-insensitive), eq_path (equals another path), count_id_le ([receipt entry id, max count]); paths are dotted keys into one scored product.

movement_reasons.scoring_policy_version_change: An approved change to scripts/scoring_v4/config/quality_score.json (_metadata.version bump) or a scorer owner, measured with /pg-scoring-change.
movement_reasons.reference_data_correction: A verified curated-data batch on an owner the pillar reads (IQM, clinical studies, RDA/UL references, dose anchors).
movement_reasons.label_source_change: A DSLD label revision, reformulation or a verified transcription correction of this product.
movement_reasons.verification_registry_change: Certification or audited-GMP registry evidence for this product or facility was added, expired or corrected.
movement_reasons.evidence_review_completed: A not-yet-reviewed or unresolved Evidence state became a recorded review conclusion.
movement_reasons.identity_resolution: PharmaGuide's own unresolved identity, role or amount reading was fixed at its owner (cleaner, enricher or resolver).
movement_reasons.safety_policy_change: An approved banned/recalled/high-risk policy or dose-safety reference change.

golden_set.status_lists: A status given as a list means policy allows any listed value (see the canary's review row).

canaries.product_name: High Absorption CoQ10 100 mg with BioPerine
canaries.notes: P0.1d provisional +2 (USP label) → 0 once Codex's USP scraper landed (USP is in covered_programs; this SKU not in USP public list). Retained catalog ID 202992 replaces duplicate DSLD ID 253169 for the same UPC 753950001831.
P0.1b anchor — NSF Sport + NSF/ANSI 173 both SKU-verified → B4a 8+4=12 (was buggy 15 in v3). USP also claimed via manufacturer signal but stays claimed_only (mfg-only never bridges).
5000 IU = 125% RDA, 50% UL. Tests B7 over-UL gate at moderate-risk threshold (should not penalize until 150%).
MK-4 (Thorne's) and MK-7 have different bioavailability profiles. Tests form-aware A1 mapping. Low v3 score worth investigating (Thorne brand-trust should help).

NAC had FDA enforcement uncertainty; current rules permit. Tests B0/B1 regulatory neutrality. Tracks the NAC single-active archetype, not product continuity for any single brand. Historical anchor (rotated out as catalog evolved): 1437 GNC NAC 600.
Most melatonin is 3-10mg; clinical evidence supports 0.3-0.5mg. Tests v4 dose-curve that rewards trial-aligned micro-dosing rather than penalizing low-mg.
NMN has no RDA/UL. Tests v4 Evidence dimension behavior on emerging compounds (rule: no clinical-trial PMID = capped Evidence credit).
Primary category is multivitamin even if older supplemental type signals drift. B5 must route to multi_or_prenatal so vitamin/mineral panel opacity uses the stricter multiplier.
Same classifier gap as 173888.

Gummies → sugar content drives B1_dietary_sugar penalty; kids-specific RDAs differ from adults. Tests v4 age-stratified dose curves. Tracks the children’s multivitamin gummy archetype, not product continuity for any single brand. Historical anchor (rotated out as catalog evolved): 178559 Spring Valley Children’s Multivitamin Gummies.
Codex's P0.1b anchor — Thorne claims NSF Sport but this product not in NSF registry → brand_only → B4a=0. Verifies manufacturer-injection guard.

canaries.brand_name: Garden of Life Dr. Formulated Probiotics
canaries.notes: Functionally a probiotic (supp_type=probiotic) marketed for prenatal use. Tests v4 dual-class routing — Dose should use probiotic per-strain CFU, not prenatal panel.

Friend of the Sea / GOED / IFOS all claimed via Nordic brand injection — none of them reach B4a (manufacturer-only). Router routes to multi_or_prenatal via 'Prenatal' keyword (consumer-targeting); no blends so B5 itself is 0 either way. Future P0.3 marine-source dimension may credit FoS/GOED/IFOS there.

canaries.product_name: Ultra Probiotic Rescue & Refresh Kit 150 Billion CFUs
canaries.notes: 50B CFU is a strong number, but whether strain identities + per-strain CFU are disclosed drives v4 Dose dim from 0/25 to ~15/25. Worth blob inspection.
POOR verdict at 39.3 is the floor of the probiotic range. Useful for v4 calibration — does the new Dose dim recover this when strain disclosure is OK?
P0.1d omega-only IFOS label test. Combined EPA+DHA 1055mg crosses general-health threshold (~250mg) and approaches cardio (1g).
Nordic Ultimate Omega is ~1280mg EPA+DHA per serving. Tests v4 dose curve at the cardio threshold.
KSM-66 has clinical trials at 300-600mg. Tests v4 form-aware herbal dose.

Sensoril clinical trials at 125-250mg (LOWER mg per trial than KSM-66 → 125mg is appropriate). Tests v4 branded-extract-specific dose math; current 49.7 may under-credit Sensoril vs KSM-66 due to mg-based comparison.

Meriva = phytosome form, ~29x more bioavailable than unformulated curcumin. Tests v4 form-aware bioavailability multiplier. Tracks the Meriva curcumin phytosome bioavailability archetype, not product continuity for any single brand. Historical anchor (rotated out as catalog evolved): 16095 Thorne Meriva-SR Curcumin Phytosome.
P0.1d BSCG label_asserted anchor. Unstandardized ashwagandha root → Dose should drop sharply (no marker content). Sugar in gummies should incur B1 penalty.
Standardized to silymarin content (typically 80%). Tests v4 marker-pct multiplier on extract.

Enricher classifies as multivitamin (because vitamins are mixed into the matrix), but the product is functionally a pre-workout stack. Current B5 router uses supp_type → wrong (multi_or_prenatal 1.3x) instead of sports_active 1.5x. Follow-up: router fix to check sports keywords even when supp_type=multivitamin.

canaries.product_name: RapidDrive Pre-Workout Amino Complex Fruit Punch
canaries.notes: supp_type=specialty + name has 'Pre-Workout' → router correctly routes to sports_active 1.5x.
P0.1d label_asserted stacking anchor (Informed Sport + Informed Choice → B4a 2+1=3). Enricher classifies as multivitamin because of added vitamin profile; product is functionally protein.
TL = brand pattern of full transparency. v3 score 85.2 is the high end of our band — useful for v4 ceiling calibration.
Creatine monohydrate at 3g is sub-optimal (clinical dose 5g). Tests v4 dose curve on under-dosed actives.
BCAA delivered as gummies is unusual. supp_type=multivitamin (because of vitamin co-pack); name has 'BCAA' → router correctly catches sports_active via keyword.

canaries.product_name: Digestive Enzymes Ultra with Betaine HCl
canaries.notes: Enzymes are dosed in activity units (DU, FCC, USP) not mg — v3 mg-based dose math under-scores them. POOR at 37.6 reveals the gap. Top v4 candidate for class-specific dose rubric. Note: enricher mis-tags primary_category=multivitamin on this enzyme product, so router routes to multi_or_prenatal. The B5 multiplier isn't critical here (likely no blend penalty); flagged for enricher primary_category audit.
Quercetin trial doses 500-1000mg. Tests v4 single-active dose curve for compounds without RDA.

canaries.product_name: Raw Organic Perfect Food Green Superfood Chocolate
canaries.notes: After the greens taxonomy refresh this product routes as greens_powder, not multivitamin and not probiotic. It contains probiotic rows, but those must not trigger the lighter probiotic B5 multiplier; use generic opacity unless a dedicated greens B5 class is introduced.

Tracks the 'high-risk active that is scored and carries CAUTION' archetype, NOT product continuity for any single brand. Vinpocetine 20 mg is dosed individually beside a partially disclosed blueberry blend. The 2026-08-24 policy review moved vinpocetine (NOOTROPIC_VINPOCETINE) from BLOCKED to CAUTION: FDA's dietary-ingredient conclusion is still tentative, while its reproductive-risk advisory stands. The 2026-09-11 IQM entry gave vinpocetine a verified scoring identity, so this product is now scored (47.2 on 2026-09-11) with CAUTION kept; quality and risk are separate outputs. v3_shipped_* are the historical v3 values. Historical anchors: 16072 Thorne Memoractiv (pre-2026-05 BLOCKED, since reformulated without vinpocetine).

Joint-support product flagged BLOCKED for a banned ingredient — surprising; the banned hit is likely in an inactive or excipient. Worth auditing why. supp_type=multivitamin (joint stack with vitamins) → router routes to multi_or_prenatal. BLOCKED verdict short-circuits scoring anyway so B5 routing is moot.
Legion claims Labdoor (manual-review-only per P0.1c routing). Tests that non-B4a cert programs don't accidentally credit B4a. Pure Encapsulations + ConsumerLab follow the same rule.

Real single-active label: verified vinpocetine quality identity with separate CAUTION policy. Dose credit is partial because no dose benchmark is available; do not describe this as a studied dose range. v3 fields retain historical policy.
Partially hydrogenated oils (FDA revoked GRAS) in an inactive row block the product. Pairs with 211448, where a watchlist excipient only informs and deducts.
Brominated vegetable oil (FDA revoked authorization in 2024) blocks a caffeinated sports drink mix; the block replaces any Dose or caffeine scoring.
Edetate disodium is blocked under NON_ROUTINE_CHELATOR, a blocking reason other than banned_ingredient; the block wins over the incomplete-data gate.

canaries.product_name: Super B Complex with Vitamin C
canaries.notes: B-complex with vitamin C inside every UL: the b_complex route with authority Evidence and no Dose ceiling.
B-100 complex whose niacin is about 286% of the 35 mg UL even at minimum directed use: Dose is set to 0 once and Safety/Hygiene does not deduct again.
Same 125 mcg D3 per softgel as 184058, but the directed maximum (2/day, 250% of UL) reaches the zero band; 184058's directed use stays at 125% (cap 10).
Nicotinic acid 500 mg against the 35 mg supplemental niacin UL: Dose 0 with CAUTION while the quality score stays visible.
Energy multivitamin at 114% of the niacin UL: the multi route caps Dose at 10 through the product-level ceiling.
A second DSLD version of the 306381 pre-workout: 600 mg caffeine/day at maximum directed use sets Dose to 0, while 306381 (300 mg/day) has no ceiling.
Fish oil 1000 mg with no EPA/DHA printed: carrier mass earns no Dose credit and Evidence is pending, so the assessment is partial.
DHA is printed, so Dose credit stands, while the Evidence review is pending and marks the assessment partial (contrast with 239467).

canaries.product_name: Purified & Clear Omega 3 Fish Oil 1000 mg
canaries.notes: Ordinary triglyceride-unspecified fish oil with EPA/DHA printed and no verification on file: neutral Verification, assessed Evidence.
Store-brand once-daily prenatal: the prenatal panel with authority Evidence and neutral Verification.
Single-strain LGG probiotic with assessed strain-family Evidence and product-level certification.
Ginkgo extract whose reviewed research does not match this label's preparation or dose: shown as an applicability gap, never as no research.
Noni fruit powder: research was reviewed and none qualifies, a completed zero that differs from a pending review.
Prosterol (saw palmetto extract) 320 mg is read as a blend header (BLEND_GENERAL); the assessment is honestly partial, but see finding F2.
Adult men's multivitamin held by the completeness gate (strict scoring contract, identity readiness): no number until identity is ready.
